If indexed deltas arrive for calls `0`, `1`, then `0` again, `latestToolCall.index` is `0` while call `1` remains active. A subsequent unindexed delta with a new ID selects index `1`. Allocate beyond the active indexes, or resolve the delta to an existing call by ID before allocating.
